messages:
emily-cs: Escalation from HarvestPay — they report streaming (SSE) disconnects mid-response on iOS when the phone connects to CarPlay / Bluetooth. App shows partial JSON chunks, then stream just stops; no final [DONE], client doesn't reconnect automatically. They saw a 499/EOF in our proxy logs. Can we triage?

jordan-support: Got it. Which SDK/version and sample request? Any x-request-id or request headers we can paste? Also is this reproducible in our lab?

emily-cs: SDK: mobile-ios v1.2.4 (internal). Sample curl they used to debug:

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "User-Agent: HarvestPay-iOS/4.3" \
  "https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams?model=text-gen-2"
```

Server started sending events, then client got a partial data chunk and connection went silent. Example client-side capture (truncated):

```
data: {"id":"evt_0","text":"Processing your invoice..."}

data: {"id":"evt_1","text":"Here is the first part of the response"}

data: {"id":"evt_2","text":"And then the socket closed mid-chunk: {"
```

No "[DONE]" arrived. Proxy shows: `upstream prematurely closed connection (EOF) while reading response header from upstream` and our gateway logs a 499 for the client.

jordan-support: Thanks. Two quick routes: 1) client-side: ensure the app records Last-Event-ID and retries with it on reconnect, 2) infra: investigate why upstream closed. Do we see any pattern (time since stream started, specific carrier, WiFi vs cellular)?

emily-cs: Customer repro steps: 1) start a long streaming response on iOS (20-30s), 2) while streaming, plug into CarPlay or toggle bluetooth connection, 3) stream dies immediately. Happens on both WiFi and cellular, appears deterministic when CarPlay starts. Device logs show NWPathMonitor flips interface quickly. They do NOT set Last-Event-ID in their client; SDK doesn't expose it currently.

nate-oncall: Tentative root cause: interface handoff (CarPlay / bluetooth) is tearing TCP socket; some middleboxes (car head unit / iOS network stack) may drop in-flight connections without clean FIN. The client sees socket closed with no proper EOF from upstream. We don't have server-side resume for SSE — unless client reconnects and sends an explicit cursor/last-id we can't continue the same generation.

nate-oncall: Repro checklist for eng: 1) capture tcpdump on gateway for a repro, 2) check if our load balancer sent FIN to upstream or upstream closed first, 3) correlate the x-request-id. Also look for any recent change to keepalive behavior (we rolled back a keepalive tweak last week).

jordan-support: Short-term mitigation to give to customer: - Implement an app-side heartbeat (send a small no-op request or ensure TCP keepalive) every ~10-15s during streaming. - Modify SDK to persist last event id (Last-Event-ID header or query param like ?cursor=) and on reconnect call the stream endpoint with that cursor to request continuation. Provide sample code.

emily-cs: Customer asked for exact sample. I pasted a tiny client patch they can add:

```
// pseudocode iOS SSE handler
onEvent(data) { storeLastEventId(data.id); process(data.text) }
onDisconnect() { attemptReconnect(); if (lastEventId) fetchStream({ cursor: lastEventId }) }

// also enable a 15s app-level ping while streaming
sendPing(){ POST /v1/ping with tiny body and same auth }
```

deploy-bot: Note: keepalive change rollback reference: ticket #4823 — there is an ongoing PR to reintroduce periodic comment keepalives from the gateway for long-lived SSE streams, but it is gated by qa.

nate-oncall: Operational action: I will spin up a gateway build in staging that injects `: keepalive\n\n` comments every 15s for user-agents matching `HarvestPay-iOS/*` so they can test without changing app. If that proves effective we can propose a broader safe default. Also requested support engineer to send us a pcap from the customer's network (they can capture on device via Charles / tcpdump on Mac when CarPlay attached).

emily-cs: Customer accepted the staging workaround. I'll schedule a short joint test and share pcap when they have it. They've also agreed to a minor SDK change to persist last-event-id this week.

jordan-support: Follow-ups: - Add a KB article with sample iOS SSE reconnect snippet and recommended heartbeat interval. - Add an internal note to product about adding server-side resume support or explicit cursor param on streams.

emily-cs: Will do. Marking this high priority for the support queue. Thanks all :thumbsup:

nate-oncall: Moving to post-incident notes once we get pcap + staging test results.

deploy-bot: Logged action items: #4823 (keepalive PR), #4891 (SDK expose last-event-id), #4892 (KB article).
